contradictions.reason: Accept deferral of the four .sdata2 facts and associated implements link. Canonical source establishes literal uses, not compiled section ownership, immutability, size, order or padding. The empty proposal makes no unsupported compiled-data change.

Accept deferral of fact:72a98402-f30d-429b-9c5b-60e9bb5b76a8: multiplication by x70 proves scaling, not attenuation without attribute-range evidence. The functionality document preserves this distinction.

Accept deferral of the three upward-hop claims. The launch helper assigns x54 and transfers to aerial motion, but its sign is not established. The exceptional predecessor 0x28 branch performs setup, sets command 1 to 2, launches and returns before ordinary animation initialization; the document accurately preserves this ordering and leaves the predecessor numeric.

Accept unresolved disposition of the unconditional creation claim. The constructor can return NULL; the fighter ignores the result and clears its accessory callback after the request. The document correctly separates callback retirement and rearming from article allocation and the article's owner/timer lifetime.

Accept unresolved disposition of the unconditional neutral-completion claim. Ground animation calls the common dispatcher, whose DownSpot and other exceptional branches preclude a universal Wait interpretation. The document explicitly qualifies ordinary completion; acceptance does not establish reachability of every dispatcher branch for Samus.
